effect_description_eng: [Main] By placing 1 Digimon card with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits from your hand as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your blue Digimon, return all of your opponent's Digimon with the same level as the placed card to the hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Return all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest level to the hand.
